verdict.rationale: Together AI exposes a well-documented public REST/OpenAI-compatible API with SDKs (TypeScript/Python), streaming, function calling, structured outputs, batch, fine-tuning, and dedicated endpoints, plus an llms.txt index confirming machine-readable docs. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
